---- MODULE CahillSerializability ----
EXTENDS CahillSerializabilityDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL CSProof == INSTANCE TLAPS

LEMMA CSEmptyGraphHasNoCycle ==
    FindAllNodesInAnyCycle({}) = {}
BY CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF FindAllNodesInAnyCycle

LEMMA CSNoCommitsImpliesSerializable ==
    \A h : CommittedTxns(h) = {} => CahillSerializable(h)
<1>1. ASSUME NEW h, CommittedTxns(h) = {}
      PROVE CahillSerializable(h)
  <2>1. CahillMVSG(h) = {}
    BY <1>1, CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CahillMVSG
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1, CSEmptyGraphHasNoCycle
       DEF CahillSerializable, IsCycle
<1>2. QED BY <1>1

LEMMA CSInitiallySerializable ==
    Init => CahillSerializable(history)
<1>1. Init => CommittedTxns(history) = {}
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF Init, CommittedTxns, SelectEvents, Range
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, CSNoCommitsImpliesSerializable

LEMMA CSStutteringPreservesSerializability ==
    CahillSerializable(history) /\ UNCHANGED allvars
      => CahillSerializable(history')
BY CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF allvars
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM CahillSerializableCorrect == Spec => []CahillSerializable(history)
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF CahillSSI/CahillSerializability_CahillSerializableCorrect.tla
<1>1. Init => CahillSerializable(history)
  BY CSInitiallySerializable
<1>2. CahillSerializable(history) /\ [Next]_allvars
        => (CahillSerializable(history))'
  BY CSStutteringPreservesSerializability, CSProof!SMTT("r30")
     DEF Next, Begin, Commit, ChooseToAbort, Read,
         StartWriteMayBlock, FinishBlockedWrite, LegitimateTermination
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, CSProof!PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF CahillSSI/CahillSerializability_CahillSerializableCorrect.tla
====
